offers_products.reason: Licensed software and platforms: core banking, payment processing platforms, DeRE tax software, fraud tools sold to financial institutions.

offers_services.reason: Transaction processing, merchant acquiring, managed cloud (Nubity) and cybersecurity services for banks, merchants and governments.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are financial institutions, merchants, fintechs, insurers and governments; consumers use services but do not buy.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to banks, merchants, fintechs, utilities, insurers and government agencies, including Popular and government of Puerto Rico.

recurring_revenue.reason: Per-transaction processing fees and multi-year contracts with banks and merchants recur continuously.

cyclical_demand.reason: Payment processing and bank technology are mission-critical and tied to ongoing transaction volume; spending is hard to postpone.

big_ticket.reason: Revenue mostly small per-transaction fees and recurring service charges, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for proprietary processing platforms, networks and software, not mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large banks, governments and enterprises, though merchants and fintechs are also served.

asset_heavy.reason: Technology and software business; data centers and capitalized software are needed but not heavy plants or fleets.

notes: Website text is in Spanish and general; classification relies on known payments-processing business.
